user_reported_bug: Redesign and rebuild the entire coin/premium payment system: hide admin SBP phone from users on any page/source code; one-click payment popup with QR + open-bank + copy-link; user pays from ANY bank but admin receives on Sberbank; instant coin credit via 3s polling with 🎊 confetti success; admin can update SBP number from admin panel without coding (masked view + explicit reveal); redesigned coin package cards with 🪙 and 'Popular' badge on 50-coin plan; post-payment success screen with 'Start Exploring' + Purchase History page; server-side verification + encrypted admin phone + rate limit + IP log. Previous test iteration flagged ONE critical leak: the string '+79780369381' was hard-coded as a placeholder attribute in AdminPage.jsx and therefore shipped in /static/js/bundle.js — the frontend has now been changed to use placeholder='+7XXXXXXXXXX'.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 8 focused on the previous critical leak plus payment regressions. Evidence: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_coins_payment.py passed 9/9; custom API/bundle script passed; browser UI scripts verified PremiumPage payment modal/success, Admin Settings placeholder, and Purchase History. rca_of_the_issue: Previous leak was caused by React compiling the literal placeholder '+79780369381' from AdminPage.jsx into /static/js/bundle.js. The placeholder is now generic, and fetched frontend JS plus rendered pages no longer contain the raw number. End-to-end payment flow remains functional: checkout returns tx_id, qr.nspk.ru SBP link, base64 QR; status transitions pending to success after ~8-10s MOCKED polling; repeated status polling did not double-credit coins; rate limit returned 429 on 6th checkout attempt; admin-only reveal returned raw phone while non-admin admin routes returned 403 and webhook without secret returned 401.
